platforms.description: New-generation 85 SX (MY2025+): new chromoly frame, rear shock mount separated from upper frame tube, head angle 63.5 deg, one-piece die-cast swingarm (2.8 kg), WP XACT AER 43 fork (278 mm) and WP XACT shock with PDS (289 mm), Formula calipers with 240/220 mm Galfer wave discs, Excel rims in 17/14 or 19/16, new seamless exhaust, Hidria digital CDI, hydraulic clutch, 6-speed. 20 mm rear axle per pass-1 chassis note (KTM media kit does not state axle sizes). Pro Circuit and Bill's Pipes list 2025 Husqvarna TC 85 and GasGas MC 85 alongside the KTM, which suggests the three share the platform (not confirmed by KTM).
platforms.models_years: KTM 85 SX 17/14 and 19/16 2025-2026(+); Husqvarna TC 85 and GasGas MC 85 2025+ (per aftermarket listings, unconfirmed by OEM)

platforms.description: 125/150 two-stroke on the 2023+ chassis. Carbureted 2023-2026 (pass 1 says 2027 125 SX goes EFI, see pass-1 platform ktm-125-2t-efi-2027). FMF lists its PowerCore 2.1 025291 for 125 SX 2023-2027 without separating the 2027 EFI bike.

2023+ KTM SX-F handlebar switch (map select, launch control, traction control, quickshift). Standard on KTM/Husqvarna 4T MX; per pass-1 notes 2024 GasGas 4T needs it added. Plugs into the 6-way diagnostic connector under the seat (per Vortex harness listing).

rider_feedback.author: Cory128 and others
rider_feedback.summary: On a 2023 KTM the switch stuck in white map, TC light flashed, quickshift would not engage, later random map changes and a stall. Checking/greasing connectors and a dealer reset helped briefly; replacing the switch fixed it. Others suggested water in the under-seat diagnostic port or chafed wires behind the number plate.
